params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root='C:\Users\Xxkan\HeavenWork\issue132'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $root) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $root -Recurse -Force }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path -Parent $root) | Out-Null
gh repo clone fengie/mhw-mods $root -- --filter=blob:none
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'clone failed' }
Set-Location $root
git fetch origin recovery/complete-mod-workflows-20260929
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'fetch recovery branch failed' }
git checkout -b fix/issue-132-workflows-20260929 origin/main
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'checkout branch failed' }
$legacy='origin/recovery/complete-mod-workflows-20260929'
$paths=@(
'docs/GAME-ADAPTER-SDK.md',
'docs/WORKFLOWS.md',
'src/MhwModManager.App/FomodInstallerWindow.cs',
'src/MhwModManager.App/ViewModels/MainWindowViewModel.Workflows.cs',
'src/MhwModManager.App/WorkflowWindow.xaml',
'src/MhwModManager.App/WorkflowWindow.xaml.cs',
'src/MhwModManager.Automation/FomodInstallerService.cs',
'src/MhwModManager.Automation/RulesEditorService.cs',
'src/MhwModManager.Automation/UpdateMigrationService.cs',
'src/MhwModManager.Core/GameAdapters.cs',
'src/MhwModManager.Core/WorkflowAnalysis.cs',
'src/MhwModManager.Storage/DeploymentMetadata.cs',
'tests/MhwModManager.AutomationTests/WorkflowTests.cs'
)
foreach($p in $paths){ git checkout $legacy -- $p; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw "legacy checkout failed: $p" } }
Write-Host '=== PORTED FILES ==='
git status --short
Write-Host '=== BUILD ==='
dotnet build .\MhwModManager.sln -c Release -p:NuGetAudit=false --nologo
$build=$LASTEXITCODE
Write-Host "BUILD_EXIT=$build"
exit $build
